fact: The National Communication Act, 2012 (Act No. 24) sets out in its Chapter XIII (ss. 73-83) the establishment of a Universal Service and Access Fund with a board of trustees, its financial resources and uses, and its annual budget, accounts and audit; only the chapter's section headings are in the capture, not the text, so the fund's sources of money are not stated here.
Budget tables: the budget for FY 2025/26 gives 291,958,444,904 SSP to 15 digital line(s). Dated by the budget document.
